name: rauf
description: Management tool for rauf autonomous coding loops
//publish: The published npm package is the launcher `@garygentry/rauf` in npm-dist/ (a thin binary bootstrapper; bare `rauf` is blocked by npm's similarity filter). This workspace root is NOT published; its version is kept in lockstep (scripts/check-versions.ts + scripts/release/lib.ts) only as the canonical monorepo version.

scripts.compile: pnpm build && bun build --compile scripts/binary-entry.ts --outfile rauf-bin
scripts.codex:generate: bun run scripts/build-codex-bundle.ts && bun run scripts/build-codex-agents.ts
scripts.codex:check: bun run scripts/build-codex-bundle.ts --check && bun run scripts/build-codex-agents.ts --check
scripts.gate: pnpm build && pnpm schema:check && pnpm version:check && pnpm codex:check && pnpm pi:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm check:docs
